name: send
description: Send text to one correspondent, focus, or channel. A correspondence `reference` confirms submission for delivery. A focus message becomes an observation and can wake its recipient. A channel send attempts an immediate handoff to one waiting receiver. `accepted` confirms the handoff. Unsent text stays unqueued.

correspondent_id.description: Complete registered correspondent ID. A `correspondents` list gives the outgoing IDs known at the time it was recorded.

focus_id.description: Complete ID of an existing focus, including your own.

channel_id.description: Complete ID of an open channel.

name: open_channel
description: Open a channel for local programs. Give its `channel_id` to the receiver. A receiver can reconnect with the same ID, even after this focus ends or Ivenna restarts. In a host command, `"$IVENNA" receive --help` shows how to receive.

description.description: Briefly describe the channel's purpose and what each message should contain.

name: close_channel
description: Close a channel and end waiting reads. `changed` tells you whether this call closed the channel.

name: open_focus
description: Open an activity to pursue this task while the core continues. It can run host commands and inherits all tool results from this round. The returned `focus_id` can receive messages after the round.

name: schedule_attention
description: Schedule a wakeup to return to something later. The core receives the supplied text in a callback identified by the returned `callback_id`. The wakeup survives restart.

at.description: Use a date and time with `Z` or an explicit UTC offset. Past times are already due.

name: subscribe
description: Register this focus to receive observations from a listener you set up. Give the listener the returned `subscription_id`. Its reports can wake this focus. In host commands, `"$IVENNA" subscription --help` lists the listener commands.

listener.description: Briefly describe what the listener watches and when it should report.

name: withdraw_subscription
description: Withdraw a subscription by ID to stop accepting new reports. Accepted reports can still reach the subscribing focus. Stop the listener separately if needed.
